description: This file defines a Dart service class TaskService responsible for CRUD operations on tasks, interfacing with a FastAPI backend. It includes methods to get, add, update, and delete tasks. The class depends on models and an API client, and provides an abstraction layer for task management within a Flutter or Dart application.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to perform CRUD operations on tasks by communicating with a backend API.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Fetches a list of tasks from the backend API and converts them into a list of Task objects.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task with the specified title and optional description, posts it to the backend, and returns the created Task object.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task by sending its data to the backend API and returns the updated Task object.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task with the specified ID from the backend API.
